髪.meaning: Your best <part>friend</part> falls asleep at a sleepover, and her <part>long hair</part> keeps growing all night: down the stairs, out the door and twice round the garden. In the morning the cat is tangled in it and the postman is knitting with it. That's a lot of <kanji>hair</kanji>.
髪.on: By noon she has braided enough of it to thatch the roofs of three garden <sound>huts</sound>.
髪.kun: The cat stays <sound>ca</sound>lm, but a <sound>mee</sound>rkat moves in and uses the braids as a hammock.

候.meaning: A weather girl hangs her coat on a <part>coat hook</part>, climbs a <part>pole</part> to a <part>diving board</part> and throws a <part>dart</part> at a map held up with one <part>staple</part>. Wherever it lands, that's tomorrow: snow in the desert, a heatwave on the glaciers. Her darts decide the whole <kanji>climate</kanji>.
候.on: Today the dart hits 'scorching', so she hands everyone in the crowd an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne.
候.kun: Bowing low like an old servant, she washes the map with <sound>soa</sound>p and walks the long <sound>roa</sound>d home, ready to serve again tomorrow.

刊.meaning: A pirate captain carves his weekly news into planks with a <part>dagger</part>, inks them, and pegs the prints along a <part>drying rack</part> made from the rigging. Gulls carry the copies to every ship at sea. It's the only way to <kanji>publish</kanji> on the waves.
刊.on: Each copy comes with a pressed pink <sound>car</sound>nation tucked inside, to cover the smell of fish.

援.meaning: At the arcade, a <part>claw machine</part> watches a kid fail ten times in a row. On the eleventh try it quietly lowers an <part>anchor</part> from its claw, hooks the biggest teddy and drops it down the chute. The machine has decided to <kanji>abet</kanji> him.
援.on: Then its motor roars like a racing <sound>en</sound>gine, and every prize inside spills out at his feet.

納.meaning: A mouse owes the cat a year of rent, so it pays in <part>thread</part>: spool after spool, wound tight and pushed <part>inside</part> the cat's slipper. The cat purrs and tears up the bill. Debt cleared, everyone happy: a neat <kanji>settlement</kanji>.
納.on: A garden <sound>gno</sound>me signs the receipt as the witness.
納.kun: The cat stores the thread in a drawer, next to a toy <sound>o</sound>ctopus and a tin of <sound>sa</sound>rdines.

票.meaning: The wind always blows from the <part>west</part>, so the village holds its vote at a hilltop <part>altar</part> and everyone tosses a folded slip into the gale. Wherever the most slips land, that's the winner, and this year it's a goat. Every flying slip is a <kanji>ballot</kanji>.
票.on: The goat's campaign manager, a lady in high <sound>hee</sound>ls, celebrates by spinning a <sound>yo</sound>-yo faster and faster.
